description: Create posts from an image the user provides (public URL). Supply caption to use the creator's words exactly as written, never rewritten; otherwise AI writes captions. Without enhance or editPrompt the image is always used exactly as uploaded (no crop, design or burned-in title). Runs asynchronously — the user is notified when posts are ready.

caption.description: Creator's caption, used exactly as written, never rewritten. No AI variants; forces one post. Omit to generate a caption from topic.

count.description: Number of caption variants/posts to generate (default 1; only more when the user asks for more)

editPrompt.description: Exact image changes; takes precedence over generic enhancement. Topic only steers the caption.

enhance.description: Let AI regenerate an enhanced version of the image. When false (default) the uploaded image is used untouched.

imageUrl.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the image

keepOriginal.description: Use the image exactly as uploaded: no crop, design, title, overlay, re-encoding or enhancement. Always true unless enhance=true or editPrompt is given; then it cannot be true.

topic.description: What the post should be about (helps the caption)

name: create_post_from_image
title: Create Post From Image
